```
class MultilineContinuationErrorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_raises_for_valueless_option_with_continuation(self):
        source = "<string>"
        string = "[service]\noptional_flag\n    continuation\n"
        with self.assertRaises(cp.MultilineContinuationError) as ctx:
            cp.RawConfigParser(allow_no_value=True).read_string(string, source=source)
        exc = ctx.exception
        self.assertEqual(exc.source, source)
        self.assertEqual(exc.lineno, 3)
        self.assertEqual(exc.line, "    continuation\n")

    def test_configparser_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(cp.MultilineContinuationError) as ctx:
            cp.ConfigParser(allow_no_value=True).read_string("[service]\noptional_flag\n    continuation\n", source="source")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.source, "source")

    def test_read_file_raises(self):
        import io
        parser = cp.RawConfigParser(allow_no_value=True)
        with self.assertRaises(cp.MultilineContinuationError):
            parser.read_file(io.StringIO("[service]\noptional_flag\n    continuation\n"), source="filesource")

    def test_valid_multiline_value_preserved(self):
        parser = cp.RawConfigParser(allow_no_value=True)
        parser.read_string("[service]\noption=value\n    continuation\n")
        self.assertEqual(parser.get("service", "option"), "value\ncontinuation")
```
